periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique angle of approximately 45 degrees tilted downwards towards the muzzle relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with a vertical-to-horizontal visual ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering where the patch narrows significantly at its lowest point toward the snout.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve at the posterior margin of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, occupying approximately 30% of the visible dorsal torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap between pinnae, approximately equal to the horizontal width of the cranial vault between them.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded semicircular curvature at the superior boundaries.
